Class

RiTa
Name

randi

Description Returns a random integer from a range. Like RiTa.random() but always returns a whole number (floor of the result).
Example 
RiTa.randi(10);     // integer in [0, 10)
RiTa.randi(5, 10);  // integer in [5, 10)
Syntax 
RiTa.randi(max);
RiTa.randi(min, max);
Parameters
numberupper bound (exclusive), or lower bound when two arguments are given
numberupper bound (exclusive) when first argument is the lower bound (optional)
Returns
numbera random integer
Related RiTa.random(), RiTa.randomSeed()
Constants RiTa.random(), RiTa.randomSeed()Constants
Note tmp_note
Platform Java / JavaScript
